worldcombat.skill.megakick.summary: The user hauls one leg fully back, leans away, then drives its whole body into a kick that sends the target flying. The wind-up is long, the cooldown heavy and it has only 5 PP; a whiff cannot be braked and slides on. The target has a real chance to step aside, and stepping aside is the cost of this move.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.use.0: Kick a single target out of formation
worldcombat.skill.megakick.use.1: Force a foe to give ground with a big wind-up
worldcombat.skill.megakick.use.2: A finishing kick into a weakened foe
worldcombat.skill.megakick.description.0: The kicking leg deals about %1$s contact damage with a %2$s block hit radius.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.description.1: Drive up to %1$s blocks along your aim at %2$s blocks per tick, kicking the first foe along the way; a friendly body or a wall stops the charge as a whiff, and running the full distance without a hit slides about %3$s more blocks before stopping.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.description.2: A hit throws the target about %1$s blocks along the kick and %2$s blocks up; the heavier the target, the shorter the throw.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.launch.on: Launch form: throws the target farther and higher, at the cost of slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.launch.off: Drive-through form: a heavier, quicker kick with little throw but a more solid impact.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.timing: Reach within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.growth.0: At level %1$s, the kick power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.growth.1: At level %1$s, the kick power rises to %2$s and the throw distance to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.preference.la: On: throws the target farther and higher, but slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown. Off (drive-through): a heavier, quicker kick with little throw but a more solid impact.
worldcombat.skill.megakick.preference.ai: It will not open with Mega Kick beyond this distance; it closes in first. The wind-up is long, so a larger value gives the foe more room to step aside.
It stops opening with Mega Kick below this fraction of its own health, unless the foe is nearly down. Higher means it values itself more.
On: prefer this kick when the target is below three tenths health. Off: it only competes as an ordinary melee option.
